title: I Have a Dream! Or Had One, Probably

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-senpai, thaaanks for hanging out☆
I came back to return the favor♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You are most welcome! A true princess
is thoroughly adept at crushing any
rematch!

—A rematch against Kawakami Princess.
Setting up the video camera,
I make sure to capture Fusaichi Pandora's
performance on tape.
choice_data_list: Everything else is all prepped too!
Everything else is all prepped too!

text_block_list.text:
A tent for Fusaichi Pandora to rest in,
iced honey drinks,
handmade sandwiches for lunch,
and plenty more.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
make sure you get my cute and cool angles♡
Peace out, yaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You seem to treat this as nothing more than
a school sports day.
Very well,
I shall shatter that frivolous mood to
pieces!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Doooryaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's nuts...!
As expected of Kawakami-senpai.
But still...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I worked super hard too, you knooowww~~!!

For a split second,
Kawakami Princess's face stiffens.
Fusaichi Pandora is still a butterfly waiting
to emerge. Even so—

Her raw talent is top-notch.
As long as I can hype her up and keep her
doing the bare minimum of training—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You are quite capable... But even so!
As a princess,
I possess a special secret technique!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Princess—Brute Force—Amazing!!
Daryaryaryaaa~!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: For real?! Guhhhh...?!
choice_data_list: Guh, is she reaching her limit...?!
Guh, is she reaching her limit...?!

text_block_list.text:
From here on out,
it's a battle of willpower!
Normally this would seal her defeat,
but the reborn Fusaichi Pandora—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(If I worked this hard and still can't win...
guess it's impossible~.
Kinda bummed, but... don't sweat it, me!)

She wasn't about to suddenly develop ironclad
grit out of nowhere. Looking at her...
she's already about to give up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I mean, I hear you, but like...

A cheer from the bottom of my lungs.
But to fire her up,
that alone won't cut it. In that case—
choice_data_list: If you win—we'll wear matching out...
If you win—we'll wear matching out...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—?!
Matching... outfits!???

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real?!
In that case—I can't afford to lose!!
You wouldn't do it the other day,
so you better make good on this!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Uoooryaaaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wha... wha...? ...Whaaaat?!
What in the world is this spuuurt~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Awwwww yeahhhhh☆

The deciding factor wasn't just Fusaichi
Pandora's improved abilities,
but more than anything—

I had learned how to "handle" her.
The art of managing her motivation led to
this victory.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay, I did it, I did it♪ Trainer,
did you see that? Did you see?
Now give me a sandwich☆
choice_data_list: Yeah, I saw it! Here you go.
Yeah, I saw it! Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*nom nom nom*...♪ Thish ish sho gud☆
Sho, dat meansh, we're doing the contrakt,
rite~?!

Fusaichi Pandora happily munches on the
sandwich. And then—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, since I won,
we're signing the contract,
right?! Contract time!
You promised☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wahoo,
my mood is totally through the roof☆ I mean,
seriously,
no one else knows how to hype me up like
you do, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you,
I ran super great! With you by my side,
an already total genius like me might run
even more amazingly!

A heartwarming lunch with the newly contracted
trainee. However, during our conversation,
surprisingly enough...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Oh, the matching outfits! About that~...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Let's talk and decide on what style to match
together☆
We're besties now, after all♪

And so,
after somehow managing to form a duo—
that night.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey Trainer, you know what?
I actually have a dream.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Well, less having one and more like,
I sometimes see it when I'm fast asleep!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Winning tons and tons of GⅠs!
And putting on a super amazing show in front
of everyone, flaunting all my cuteness♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can become like that
someday.
Just like in that dream.

The dream Fusaichi Pandora sees—
a butterfly's dream.
A dream like reality,
reality like a dream.

Yet one day,
I will surely make it a reality.
Though the road ahead may be long,
I vowed to turn her into an incredible
horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(But honestly... there's something
kinda weird about that dream...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Even before I started running...
ever since I was tiny,
I've had it over and over.
Could that dream actually be...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Some kind of destiny, maybe?
